judgments.decision: Distinguish ordinary metre, unaccented scale inner beams, and expressive phrase grouping; do not blanket-apply either cut-every-beat or preserve-all-long-beams.
Protect actual times and correct member counts on both sides; the first post-barline head need not be the bar onset.

judgments.decision: Keep two-note alternation and logical midpoint distinct from normal beam members or visual centring; graphical workarounds require structural and relayout checks.
A tutorial software joining condition does not authorise merging independent musical layers or deciding actual hand allocation.
